==Skin Upgrades==
The '''Operator''' has two skins in total. This includes:
#The Default skin.
#One skin that can be obtained from [[Crates]].
{{Tabber
|Default
|{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = Default
|Icon1 = [[File:DefaultOperatorIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:DefaultOperator0.png|200px]]
|Pale skin, black shirt, cap, headset, pants and gloves, and grey shoes.

Wields a TEC-9 to attack enemies.
|[[File:DefaultOperator1.png|200px]]
|Black pockets on belt.
|[[File:DefaultOperator2.png|200px]]
|Slightly translucent blue shades.
|[[File:DefaultOperator3.png|200px]]
|Grey straps with black pockets on shoulders.

Cap, headset and shades replaced with a black helmet and a white visor.

Now wields an MP5K.
|[[File:DefaultOperator4.png|200px]]
|Grey straps with pockets on left leg.
|[[File:DefaultOperator5.png|200px]]
|Black vest, grey shoulder-pads and black face mask.

Now wields an MPX.
|[[File:DefaultOperator6.png|200px]]
|Black knee-pads, grey pads around waist with pockets on them, black backpack, black antenna on helmet and a bulkier right shoulder-pad.

Larger vest, mask now covers its entire face, replacing the visor with six white dots.
}}
|Pirate
|The {{Color|Pirate}} skin can be obtained from the [[Pirate Crate|{{Color|Pirate|Pirate Crate}}]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Pirate}}
|Icon1 = [[File:PirateOperatorIconIG.png|128px]]

|Dark skin, black hair, cyan head scarf, white shirt, brown gloves with knuckles on it, cyan sash around waist, black pants with tan cuffs and brown shoes.

Wields a black and blue semi-automatic pistol to attack enemies.
|[[File:PirateOperator1.png|200px]]
|Brown strap with yellow buckle.
|[[File:PirateOperator2.png|200px]]
|Brown cutlass sheath and brown eyepatch with cyan cross symbol.
|[[File:PirateOperator3.png|200px]]
|Brown elbow-pad on left arm and brown knife strapped on left leg.

Now wields an black and blue submachine gun.
|[[File:PirateOperator4.png|200px]]
|Black cloak that covers its face.
|[[File:PirateOperator5.png|200px]]
|Blue coat and white bags on waist.

Cloak is now blue and shirt is now black.

Now wields an black and blue rifle with a scope.
|[[File:PirateOperator6.png|200px]]
|Brown shoulder pads, face is now completely covered with a black mask and skull.

Upgraded cloak with yellow outlines.

==Trivia==
*The icon for the default skin is different from the actual skin, as it has the glasses from Level 2 while also holding both the TEC-9 and MP5K at the same time.

==Update History==
''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Operator]]. Check the main article for statistical changes.''
*'''19 June 2026''' - [[v2.1.0]]
**'''Operator''' added.
**{{Bug}} Does not play any sounds.
**{{Bug}} Level 6 default skin has two pockets on its left leg inside of each other, causing z-fighting.
*'''19 June 2026''' - [[v2.1.0|v2.1.1a]]
**{{Bugfix}} Now plays sounds.
*'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]]
**New skin: {{Color|Pirate}}
*'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]]
**Default skin icon technically replaced as it uses a newly uploaded Roblox image, however the new icon is completely identical to the one previously used.
**Updated the icon for the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] version of the default skin.
